Native R nonlinear parameter multiverses, FPCA clustering and distance-contract sensitivity

etr_native_multiverse_clustering.Rd

Five independent Python-free numerical functions evaluating complete analyst-declared sensitivity grids, K-means over fitted FPCA scores, and comparisons of raw distance rankings and nearest-neighbor structures.

Usage

etr_lyapunov_parameter_sensitivity(trajectories, curve, dimensions,
  embedding_dimensions, delays, theiler_windows, fit_intervals, max_horizon,
  delay_units = "samples", theiler_window_units = "samples",
  fit_units = "samples", max_horizon_units = "samples")
etr_kantz_parameter_sensitivity(trajectories, curve, dimensions,
  embedding_dimensions, delays, radii, min_neighbors, theiler_windows,
  fit_intervals, max_horizon, delay_units = "samples",
  theiler_window_units = "samples", fit_units = "samples",
  max_horizon_units = "samples")
etr_rqa_parameter_sensitivity(trajectories, curve, dimensions,
  embedding_dimensions, delays, theiler_windows, min_diagonal_lengths,
  min_vertical_lengths, radii = NULL, target_recurrence_rates = NULL,
  delay_units = "samples", theiler_window_units = "samples",
  distance_metric = "euclidean")
etr_cluster_fpca_scores(fpca, n_clusters, n_components = NULL,
  random_state = 0L, n_init = "auto")
etr_trajectory_distance_sensitivity(trajectories, specifications,
  dimensions = NULL, dimension_weights = NULL, neighbor_k = 3L)

Arguments

trajectories

Complete native common-grid trajectories; no preprocessing is applied.

curve

Source zero-based curve index or exact curve identifier.

dimensions

Nonempty explicit list of source dimension names; NULL uses all for distance sensitivity only.

embedding_dimensions

Nonempty distinct integer grid, all >=2.

delays

Nonempty distinct positive sample-delay grid.

theiler_windows

Nonempty distinct nonnegative sample exclusion grid.

fit_intervals

Nonempty list of distinct inclusive integer (start,end) sample-index fitting horizons.

max_horizon

Maximum positive integer forward divergence horizon in samples.

delay_units

Samples only; other physical-time units are not implemented in this restricted native stage.

theiler_window_units

Samples only.

fit_units

Samples only.

max_horizon_units

Samples only.

radii

Finite distinct positive radius grid for fixed-threshold recurrence or Kantz neighborhoods.

min_neighbors

Nonempty distinct positive integer minimum-neighbor grid for Kantz.

min_diagonal_lengths

Nonempty distinct positive integer RQA diagonal-line length grid.

min_vertical_lengths

Nonempty distinct positive integer RQA vertical-line length grid.

target_recurrence_rates

Not implemented: must remain NULL; no adaptive threshold substitution.

distance_metric

Euclidean only in RQA sensitivity.

fpca

Native finite FPCA fit with complete retained score matrix.

n_clusters

Number of K-means groups, >=2 and no greater than number of scores.

n_components

Number of retained fitted FPCA score columns, NULL uses all.

random_state

Isolated base-R RNG seed, not scikit-learn/NumPy-identical.

n_init

Positive number of independent K-means starts or auto (one R start).

specifications

At least two unique named distance specifications with method functional_l2, discrete_frechet or dtw and explicit compatible DTW options.

dimension_weights

Finite nonnegative weights on selected channels, with at least one positive.

neighbor_k

Declared number of nearest other curves in each metric, between 1 and n_curves - 1.

Value

A native numerical sensitivity result containing complete specification and descriptive summary tables, a labeled FPCA K-means partition, or complete unstandardized distance matrices and neighbor comparisons.

Details

All sensitivity summaries describe variation over the declared specifications, not sampling intervals, automatic selection, or chaos probabilities. The RQA estimator is currently fixed-radius Euclidean and omits the Python center-of-recurrence-mass metric; target-recurrence-rate thresholding fails closed. Only sample-unit divergence parameterization is qualified. R's Hartigan-Wong K-means initializer and random streams differ from scikit-learn. Unstandardized pairwise distance correlations are descriptive because distances are not independent observations. The source-name register is not full API contract certification.
